title: Twelve

panels.shot: Wide. The great clock face reads 12:00. Two small figures on the cornice, a man and a dog. Rings spread in the last of the rain. Far below, the storm swallows a tiny falling shape.

lines.text: I didn't push him. Time did. He taught me that too.
